summary: Learn facilities management and workplace experience training with KPI dashboards, maintenance planning, compliance mapping, and practical templates. Book now.
lede: Facilities and asset management training helps building and workplace professionals structure service delivery and monitor operational performance. Participants analyse work-order and occupancy data, prioritise maintenance using asset criticality, and develop service standards, KPI dashboards, and workplace improvement roadmaps. It is designed for facilities managers, maintenance supervisors, workplace experience managers, and other professionals involved in building services.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with buildings, services, or workplace operations and need a more structured way to measure, prioritise, and report facilities performance.
audience: Health and safety coordinators in workplace environments
modules: Facilities Management and Workplace Experience Foundations
prerequisites: You should bring a willingness to work with operational data, service logs, occupancy information, and sample policies. A laptop with spreadsheet software is recommended for dashboard and matrix exercises, and familiarity with your own facilities workflows will help you adapt the templates more quickly.
